crossRefs.note: He commanded the multitudes to sit down on the grass; and he took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to…
He commanded them that everyone should sit down in groups on the green grass.
They sat down in ranks, by hundreds and by fifties.
For they were about five thousand men. He said to his disciples, “Make them sit down in groups of about fifty each.”
Jesus said, “Have the people sit down.” Now there was much grass in that place. So the men sat down, in number about…
